name: simrail-streamdeck
description: Stream Deck plugin for SimRail's MQTT interface

scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.simrailmqtt.streamdeck.sdPlugin --force -o dist
scripts.preview:build: rolldown scripts/gallery.ts --platform node --format esm -o dist/preview/gallery.mjs && node dist/preview/gallery.mjs
scripts.build:ui: rolldown scripts/gen-ui-catalog.ts --platform node --format esm -o dist/gen-ui-catalog.mjs && node dist/gen-ui-catalog.mjs
